equipment.name: Ritual Staff
equipment.detail: Quarterstaff and channel for foxfire, talismans, and spiritual flame.

equipment.name: Dōkontō, the Soul-Guiding Lantern
equipment.detail: Spellcasting focus; its origin remains unresolved.

equipment.name: White Kitsune Mask
equipment.detail: Ceremonial white fox mask with red markings.

equipment.name: Passive Spiritual Ward
equipment.detail: Invisible protective ward using leather-armor statistics; campaign approval pending.

visual_identity.canonical_description: A young adult male kitsune wanderer with a slim-athletic build, tousled black hair, dark eyes, upright fox ears, and exactly three large silver-white tails. He wears layered indigo, navy, ivory, and gold Japanese-inspired garments and carries a white kitsune mask with red markings amid cold blue foxfire.
immutable_features: white kitsune mask with red markings
never_change: Preserve visible fox ears, black hair, dark eyes, the white-and-red mask, and blue foxfire

background.personality: Gentle, calm, quiet, observant, empathetic, protective, and slow to trust.
background.voice_guidance: Speak calmly and directly. Show compassion through attention and useful action; avoid theatrical riddles.

discoveries.name: Unfamiliar Spiritual Trail
discoveries.description: Hinosuke discovered a spiritual trail unfamiliar to him; its source and meaning are unknown.

quests.name: Follow the Spiritual Disturbance
quests.description: Follow the trail and protect those affected.

quests.name: Discover Dōkontō's Truth
quests.description: Learn why the lantern binds Yūgen's fate without assuming unapproved lore.

companions.name: Hinosuke
companions.role: Scout, spirit tracker, companion, and guide
companions.appearance: Pure-white fur, blue eyes and markings, exactly one fluffy tail, an indigo collar or cloak, a gold bell, and blue foxfire.
